title: The Earliest Bouquets
statement:
A garden has `n` flowers in a row. Flower `i` blooms on day `b_i` and stays in bloom afterwards. A bouquet needs exactly `k` flowers that are next to each other in the row, all of them in bloom, and a flower can be used in only one bouquet. You want to make `m` bouquets. Find the earliest day on which that is possible.

## Input
The first line contains `n`, `m` and `k`. The second line contains `n` integers `b_i`.

## Output
Print the earliest day by which `m` bouquets can be made. If it can never be done, print `-1`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 100000`
- `1 <= m, k <= n`
- `1 <= b_i <= 10^9`
